note: Phase 18 (BPMN e2e retirement, plan §5.3/§21.3) retargeted tests/e2e/lite-mandatory-spreadsheet.spec.ts from the deleted BPMN spreadsheet-to-BPMN pipeline (src/spreadsheet/**) to ARIS's Phase 12 Excel layer (src/aris/excel/**), which by reading source was found to be a completely separate, from-scratch implementation that reuses only the low-level secure ZIP preflight (xlsxPreflight.ts/archivePreflight.ts, documented in xlsxReader.ts as 'REUSED, never reimplemented'). It is official-template-only (no free-form mapping wizard), .xlsx-only (no CSV path at all), produces one atomic in-memory AML document per import (no folder/file writes, hence no destination collision/rollback/report/mapping-preset concepts), and has no wired-up cancel affordance despite the underlying worker supporting AbortSignal. buildAmlFromArisWorkbook additionally reads only workbook.models/.objects/.connections/.attributes: Lanes, FreeText, Styles, Glossary, and cross-model Assignment ('call') links are parsed and validated but silently dropped when generating AML — a real, disclosed product gap, not a test gap. Of the original 14 tests / 10 requirement ids, 9 tests survive (reduced/consolidated) and 5 ids (XLS-02, XLS-04, XLS-06, XLS-09, XLS-10) are deliberately left unbound below (like UI-02/UI-03/UI-07 in mandatory-ui-accessibility-evidence.json): their browserTests entries intentionally still name the pre-retarget titles, which no longer exist in the file, so the release-reporter gate fails honestly on each rather than silently passing or being rebound to an unrelated test.

requirements.requirement: Cancellation, destination collisions, rollback, reports, and mapping-preset reuse.

These titles no longer exist in the file; kept here to fail the release-reporter gate honestly rather than silently pass.
